meta.title: dsh-argp
meta.description: Context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): deterministic label-addressed eviction of tool results (0 LLM), prose condensation only inside compaction transactions (double-gated), an egress gate that never sends a request that would necessarily overflow, and label-addressed recall of originals from the append-only log. Zero settings knobs; originals stay in the log.
